reviews.text: I'm so happy with the care Lía received! A very kind, attentive, and professional team. They helped me with all the arrangements for her trip and were on top of things every step of the way. It's so reassuring to have them on board. Thank you so much for everything! 🐾 …

I've been taking Vera to Vivero Veterinary Clinic for eight years, first in Fuenlabrada and then when they opened in Chamartín (since it was more convenient for me). Erika and Claudia are wonderful; they treat my girl exceptionally well. For dermatology, Jose is the best; if you have pets with skin problems, I highly recommend him. Thank you always for your professionalism.

We’ve had such a wonderful experience with Vivero! The entire team has been incredibly friendly, accommodating, and patient with my limited Spanish, even helping with translation when needed. Communication was excellent throughout our dog’s surgery, and they also made getting her European pet passport seamless. We’ve had a great grooming experience as well. The facility is clean, the staff is caring and professional, and we’re so grateful to have found them. Highly recommend!
Thanks for the rating, Roberto!

A heartfelt thank you to the entire team, and especially to José, for your kindness and professionalism. You made my little Snow's short life happier and with so much less pain. ❤️
Snow sends you kisses from the other side of the rainbow. 🌈🐾
The hair treatment I received left my hair incredibly soft. The staff is very professional and the results were remarkable.
The place is very nice and the staff is attentive. Overall, a good experience.
They have a modern style and know how to adapt to trends. I'm always very happy with the final result, a 10 out of 10.

After visiting dozens of veterinarians, we finally found a clinic that truly examined my dog ​​and stabilized his chronic illnesses. All the staff are fantastic, and they have several specialists who come to the clinic as needed.
They are super professional people, they explain everything, their honesty is appreciated, thank you very much for your attention….
Thank you so much for your review, Raquel!

I want to thank the entire team at the veterinary clinic for the excellent care they've given my dog, Gastón. On January 15, 2026, he had surgery to remove a tumor from his paw, and since then they've been very attentive to his progress, checking on him several times a week and helping me with cleanings and bandage changes.

Thanks to Dr. Eva for the initial examination, to José for the surgery, and to Erika and the rest of the team for their care and attention throughout the entire process. I'm also grateful that they recommended electrochemotherapy to ensure no cancerous cells remained.

They are great professionals and, above all, wonderful people. I recommend this clinic without hesitation.
They have always treated us very well!

My experience was very positive, after going around to too many "big" hospitals in the north of Madrid and leaving very disappointed by the terrible treatment I received and their inability to solve anything at all... Anyone who wants their pets to receive the TIME and attention they deserve needs clinics like this one, with much more humane treatment and more efficient staff.

From my very first interaction with this veterinary clinic, the experience has been excellent. The entire team has demonstrated a high level of professionalism, with a very pragmatic and, above all, transparent approach. My dog, Lana, presented with complex symptoms, and in an orderly and sequential manner, they performed tests, ruled out possibilities, and explained each step to me until they arrived at the diagnosis.

Unfortunately, it was an inoperable cancer, but from the beginning, they spoke to me honestly about the situation, managed expectations with great sensitivity, and proposed an appropriate treatment that, so far, has been going very well. They have always been careful to share clear information before performing any procedure, provide quotes in advance, and answer all my questions.

Their treatment of Lana has been impeccable: very professional, but also very loving and compassionate. I am deeply grateful and happy with the service they have provided. Without a doubt, this veterinary clinic is highly recommended.
Clinic with terrible customer service. Rude, not even a single smile (only when you pay). Very dissatisfied, I won't be back!

I was already a client of this clinic in Fuenlabrada; a friend recommended it to me because of the dermatological problems my dog ​​was having. Since we tried it, I've taken her for walks without hesitation, so I'm delighted that they're now closer. I recommend it 100%. They have a very personal approach with the animals, and we're very at ease since Jara has been in their care.

My dog ​​goes happily to his baths and comes back with a freshly styled haircut! I don't know how they give him such beautiful hairstyles and leave his hair looking so good that people stop me in the street to ask me to lengthen it!

Well, it's quite simple! Since they started, the prices were reasonable, and they also had vaccination campaigns with great benefits.

Now, they've increased their prices significantly, and the service isn't the same. Are they part of a franchise?

My question 🙄
The answer:

It's the law of the market; prices change according to market fluctuations. You're free to decide where you want to go or not, as well as whether or not you want to pay a certain amount for a service. Your comments and wishes toward us are not only childish but also a reflection of the kind of person you are.

You've already expressed your opinion, and I hope you feel satisfied.

We had a trauma emergency with our little one and they were wonderful. They were incredibly kind, located the orthopedic surgeon, and saw us the same day, even though it was Christmas Eve. We are very grateful for their care and especially to Rodrigo Zuñiga, who is a fantastic orthopedic surgeon. Thank you!

I am so grateful to the veterinarians at the clinic. From the first time I took my cats there, they have handled every appointment and every issue in a very professional and caring way. I'm adopting another kitten now, and I have no doubt that they will continue to be my clinic of choice.

100% PROFESSIONAL
Excellent service, they solved all my little furry friend's problems.
I take my two dogs there and I'm delighted! The service is excellent, they're very professional and incredibly kind to the dogs. I recommend it 100%.

I'm absolutely delighted with this clinic! I took my 12-year-old Pomeranian to Laura for grooming. I'm usually very careful about where I take my dog ​​since he's older and has a lot of hair. Laura is a super friendly woman who did an impeccable job. In fact, I'd say it's the first time in so many years that my dog ​​comes out happy after his bath. Her passion and love for animals are evident! What a pleasure to meet people like this. Highly recommended.
Excellent veterinarian. We have a 3-month-old kitten and we are delighted. Very good care and service.

I took my dog, a long-haired Bichon Maltese, to the vet. My dog ​​is almost two years old, and I've been taking her to the vet since she was three months old. I called to make an appointment at the groomer because she was dirty and had some knots in her coat, as I had recently had surgery and couldn't bathe her. Laura attended to her, and I clearly asked her to only bathe her and not to brush or touch her long coat, as I would brush her at home. When I picked her up, I found that she had used a detangling tool and removed all her hair, leaving her looking completely different.

I called Laura, very upset, and she told me she hadn't used the detangling tool, only the wide-tooth comb, but the result clearly shows the opposite. I'm very upset and disappointed because I trusted that they would respect my instructions and take care of my dog's coat, and it's been the complete opposite. It's a real shame for me, and with how upset I am, I don't think I'll ever go back to the clinic.
Excellent service, the staff were super polite
My dog ​​Iru had a complicated skin problem, and they found the cause through a series of tests.
Very professional and caring. We took our adopted canaries there, one of which was quite sick when we took him in, and they helped them a lot.
Excellent experience. Meticulous attention, pampering of pets, and involvement in their follow-up. Extensive explanations and advice. Plus, a friendly, personal touch. Very good facilities.

Highly recommended. The vet who was there on Saturday gave us excellent service, even though we arrived late, at 1:45 pm, because our dog had just stepped on something and suddenly started walking strangely.
We recommend it and will always go here :)

I must say I am more than satisfied.
Dr. María Cadenas Ayerra was EMPATHETIC, which many doctors lack.

I felt listened to, but above all, she knew how to properly assess my furry son, Baby.
She not only gave him a complete checkup but also created a customized diet to improve his symptoms.

I have already recommended the clinic to my friends.

I have no words other than to say a HUGE THANK YOU to the entire team, but especially to Dr.

I couldn't be more grateful to this clinic. They are true professionals with exceptional compassion and empathy, both with patients and their owners!

I took my 15-year-old dog in because she had a serious mouth infection that required urgent surgery. In less than a week, they performed all the necessary tests to ensure she could tolerate the anesthesia and to confirm that everything was in order. From the first consultation on Monday to the surgery on Thursday, the process was quick, efficient, and, most importantly, successful.

In addition to the excellent care, I want to highlight how well they explain each step of the treatment and the detailed medical report they provide after each consultation or test. Their transparency and the care they take inspire great confidence.

Honestly, if your dog has a condition that requires true professionals and you want to ensure they receive the best care, this is the place for you.

Special thanks to Dr. María, Dr. José, and the colleague who helped us with all the payment arrangements—they are all truly wonderful!

I've attached photos from the day of the operation and the recovery.
They take excellent care of our pets, and the tests they request are always very consistent. Thank you.

Last year I took my cat Memphis to the clinic and the treatment was excellent and professional.

He was having an allergic reaction and had pulled out some fur on his neck. At another clinic, they barely saw him and told me to go home and wait for it to go away on its own. After almost 2 months and almost €200 spent on 3 visits, where they only prescribed him an allergy medicine at one time, the reaction continued.

So I switched to this clinic and they immediately ran blood tests, an earwax test, a physical evaluation, etc. They prescribed an allergy medicine, ear drops, a dewormer, etc. And, like a miracle cure, the kitten was cured in a matter of days.

I was truly grateful. Now that I felt a little lump in his skin, I will take him back to this clinic, which has given me so much confidence!
Maya has been treated wonderfully; you can tell they are professionals and that they love animals!
Excellent service, they helped me solve some problems with my dog's documents so we could travel.
We are delighted with them; they treat our little one wonderfully, he loves going, and they are incredibly attentive and professional. We recommend them 100%.

We are so grateful to the Chamartín Veterinary Clinic for all the support they provided for Lupita. They have helped us on several occasions with different services, always demonstrating professionalism and commitment.

From handling the paperwork for traveling with your pet to providing medical care, every experience has been excellent. The staff is friendly, attentive, and it's clear they genuinely care about our pets' well-being. Their service has always been clear, prompt, and efficient.

Without a doubt, I recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a reliable and professional place for comprehensive pet care. Thank you for all the support you gave Lupita!

We are delighted with this veterinary clinic. From the very first moment, the service has been exceptional, and we especially want to highlight María, who has become our trusted veterinarian.

They are a super professional team and, at the same time, very friendly, something we value immensely when it comes to the care of our pets. They always take the time to explain everything to us in detail and treat our furry friends with so much love.

Without a doubt, we recommend them 100%. Thank you for taking such good care of them!
A perfect 10 experience every time, the girls are absolutely lovely, and they treat Pippa like she's their own 😍 …
Thank you so much, Claudia!
Excellent service and attention. Exceptional hairdressing service. 100% recommended.
100% recommended.
Highly professional and with exceptional service, they solved a problem with my cat after I had visited several veterinary clinics. I definitely recommend them.
Thank you so much !
The attention and care is fabulous.
Excellent attention and service; they treat animals as well as, or even better than, people! Highly recommended.

Excellent veterinary clinic, with great service and exceptional care for pets. They also offer WhatsApp, which makes scheduling appointments and communication much easier if they're your regular vet. Highly recommended.
Thank you so much, Roberta!
